name: globall-cloud
description: Production logistics platform for China/UAE to Iraq shipping — control plane, payments (QiCard/FIB), notifications

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const src=process.cwd(),out=path.join(src,'dist'),skip=new Set(['.git','.github','.devcontainer','.vscode','node_modules','dist','scripts','supabase','tests','docs']);fs.rmSync(out,{recursive:true,force:true});fs.mkdirSync(out,{recursive:true});function cp(rel){const s=path.join(src,rel),d=path.join(out,rel);const st=fs.lstatSync(s);if(st.isDirectory()){fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});for(const n of fs.readdirSync(s))cp(path.join(rel,n))}else fs.copyFileSync(s,d)}for(const n of fs.readdirSync(src)){if(!skip.has(n)&&n!=='package.json'&&n!=='package-lock.json'&&!/^(.*\\.(md|MD|txt|patch|sql|dump|bak|log|pem|key|crt|tf|tfvars))$/.test(n))cp(n)};fs.writeFileSync(path.join(out,'release.json'),JSON.stringify({service:'globall-cloud',commit:process.env.CF_PAGES_COMMIT_SHA||process.env.CF_PAGES_GIT_COMMIT_SHA||'unknown',ref:process.env.CF_PAGES_BRANCH||'main'})+'\\n');console.log('Cloudflare Pages: dist bundle created')"
